name: hazel_weir_procedural_graph_v1_1
description: Procedural Graph with early capital compounding (Days 0-12) and late harvest freeze (Days 13-30).

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, and oracle price drop signals.

nodes.name: Early Capital Compounding
nodes.description: Days 0-12 growth engine: rapidly reinvests free cash above payroll into Strawberry seeds, plot expansions, and up to 9 hands.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces pre-midnight surplus liquidation when hour >= 18 and cash < payroll due.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges (Carrots, Tomatoes, Eggs) to capture 2x-3.5x price premiums.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing low-margin inventory before workers deliver crops.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk) immediately before opponent market gluts.

nodes.name: Late Harvest Velocity Freeze
nodes.description: From Day 13 onward: freezes land expansion and slow crops; channels 100% labor to continuous watering and harvest liquidation.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines (planting, watering, feeding livestock, harvesting) using available action slots.

attributes.condition: hour >= 18 and day > 1 and net_available_cash < midnight_payroll_due
attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; execute emergency batch sales of non-feed inventory to ensure payroll is covered before hour 24.
attributes.pitfalls: Never trigger on Day 0-1 when cash is abundant ($3,000); do not sell Wheat below livestock feed reserve.

attributes.guidance: Aggressively purchase Strawberry seeds, expand plots, and hire hands up to 9-10 to maximize early compounding returns.
attributes.pitfalls: Always reserve (hands_count * 120 + 100) cash for midnight payroll; do not exceed 10 hands.

attributes.guidance: Enforce strict zero-buy policy on new land and slow seeds. Prioritize worker watering and fast harvest liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not buy Strawberry seeds after Day 13 as they will not mature before Day 30.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and money >= 1200.0 and day between 3 and 25
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 2 market slots for shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes); prioritize selling into active shop windows for 2x-3.5x premium.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not buy shop seeds if shed is over 85 capacity or if cash is needed for wage reserve.

attributes.guidance: Schedule batch sale of highest-volume holdings (Wheat, Fertilizer) to maintain at least 20 empty slots in shed.
attributes.pitfalls: Never evict feed Wheat when animals are hungry; clear shed before step 720 terminal drop.

attributes.guidance: Preemptively dump held luxury commodities (Wool, Milk) before opponent supply collapses open market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not sell into already collapsed $1.00 markets unless shed is overflowing.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch idle hands to tilling, watering, feeding, and harvest collection in priority order.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not leave Strawberry plots unwatered; ensure hands drop carried items before end of turn 717.
